definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.110) interface of an object lists the methods with their parameters, returned value and exceptions, word for word 2023 3.109 apart from 'may'/'can'; the rule names an interface as the language construct (§2002:4 4.111 'A grouping of method prototypes'), defined alike in 2023 3.110, so scope is unchanged.
